subject: Confirmation of Your Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip from New York to London. Your flight details are as follows: - Flight Number: ABC123 - Departure Date: 25th October 2021 - Departure Time: 10:00 AM - Arrival Time: 1:00 PM Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before the departure time. We wish you a pleasant journey and look forward to welcoming you on board. Best regards, The Airlines Team
